chunks_partition.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α), (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1.flatten ++ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2 = xs ∧ (∀ c ∈ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1, c.length = n) ∧ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2.length < n

chunks_exact.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (s : Slice α) (n : Usize), 0 < n.val → core.slice.Slice.chunks_exact s n ⦃ fun it => (it.chunks.map Slice.val).flatten ++ it.remainder.val = s.val ∧ (∀ c ∈ it.chunks, c.val.length = n.val) ∧ it.remainder.val.length < n.val ⦄

inner_step.statement: ∀ (bytes : Slice U8) (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hlen : 4 ≤ bytes.val.length) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val ≤ U32.max) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val + (a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val) ≤ U32.max), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0.body { chunks := bytes :: cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun r => ∃ av bv, r = .cont ({ chunks := cs, remainder := rem }, av, bv) ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val = a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val) ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → bv.val[i]!.val = b.val[i]!.val + (a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val)) ⦄

inner_loop_bounded.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ cs, 4 ≤ c.val.length) (hlen : cs.length ≤ 5552) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0 { chunks := cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (out.1.val[i]!.val, out.2.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun cs a.val[i]!.val b.val[i]!.val i ⦄

remainder_inner_loop_bounded.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ cs, 4 ≤ c.val.length) (hlen : cs.length ≤ 5552) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop1 { chunks := cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (out.1.val[i]!.val, out.2.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun cs a.val[i]!.val b.val[i]!.val i ⦄

chunk_count_bound.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem source : Slice U8) (hpartition : (cs.map Slice.val).flatten ++ rem.val = source.val) (hfull : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.val.length = 4) (hlen : source.val.length ≤ 22208), cs.length ≤ 5552

lane_rem.statement: ∀ (self : algo.U32X4) (q : U32), 0 < q.val → algo.U32X4.Insts.CoreOpsArithRemAssignU32.rem_assign self q ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.val[i]!.val = self.val[i]!.val % q.val ⦄

lane_normalize.statement: ∀ (self : algo.U32X4), algo.U32X4.Insts.CoreOpsArithRemAssignU32.rem_assign self algo.Adler32.compute.MOD ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.val[i]!.val = self.val[i]!.val % 65521 ∧ out.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520 ⦄

outer_step.statement: ∀ (chunk : Slice U8) (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : U32) (av bv : algo.U32X4) (hlen : chunk.val.length = 22208) (ha : a.val ≤ 65535) (hb : b.val ≤ 65535) (hav : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hbv : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → bv.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0.body 22208#usize a { chunks := chunk :: cs, remainder := rem } b av bv ⦃ fun r => ∃ (qs : List (Slice U8)) (b' : U32) (av' bv' : algo.U32X4), r = .cont ({ chunks := cs, remainder := rem }, b', av', bv') ∧ (qs.map Slice.val).flatten = chunk.val ∧ (∀ q ∈ qs, q.val.length = 4) ∧ b'.val = (b.val + 22208 * a.val) % 65521 ∧ b'.val ≤ 65520 ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av'.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).1 % 65521 ∧ bv'.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).2 % 65521 ∧ av'.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520 ∧ bv'.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) ⦄

laneRun_congr.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (a b c d i : Nat) (ha : a % 65521 = c % 65521) (hb : b % 65521 = d % 65521), (AdlerProof.laneRun cs a b i).1 % 65521 = (AdlerProof.laneRun cs c d i).1 % 65521 ∧ (AdlerProof.laneRun cs a b i).2 % 65521 = (AdlerProof.laneRun cs c d i).2 % 65521

laneRun_append.statement: ∀ (xs ys : List (Slice U8)) (a b i : Nat), AdlerProof.laneRun (xs ++ ys) a b i = AdlerProof.laneRun ys (AdlerProof.laneRun xs a b i).1 (AdlerProof.laneRun xs a b i).2 i

outer_loop.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : U32) (av bv : algo.U32X4) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.val.length = 22208) (ha : a.val ≤ 65535) (hb : b.val ≤ 65535) (hav : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hbv : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → bv.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0 22208#usize { chunks := cs, remainder := rem } a b av bv ⦃ fun out => ∃ qs : List (Slice U8), (qs.map Slice.val).flatten = (cs.map Slice.val).flatten ∧ (∀ q ∈ qs, q.val.length = 4) ∧ out.1.val % 65521 = (b.val + 22208 * cs.length * a.val) % 65521 ∧ out.1.val ≤ 65535 ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.2.1.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).1 % 65521 ∧ out.2.2.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).2 % 65521 ∧ out.2.1.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520 ∧ out.2.2.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) ⦄

outer_iter_wp.statement: ∀ (size : Usize) (it : core.slice.iter.ChunksExact U8) (a b : U32) (av bv : algo.U32X4) (hsize : size.val = 22208) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ it.chunks, c.val.length = 22208) (ha : a.val ≤ 65535) (hb : b.val ≤ 65535) (hav : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hbv : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → bv.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0 size it a b av bv ⦃ fun out => ∃ qs : List (Slice U8), (qs.map Slice.val).flatten = (it.chunks.map Slice.val).flatten ∧ (∀ q ∈ qs, q.val.length = 4) ∧ out.1.val % 65521 = (b.val + 22208 * it.chunks.length * a.val) % 65521 ∧ out.1.val ≤ 65535 ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.2.1.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).1 % 65521 ∧ out.2.2.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun qs av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i).2 % 65521 ∧ out.2.1.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520 ∧ out.2.2.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) ⦄

mul_wp.statement: ∀ (self : algo.U32X4) (rhs : U32) (h : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → self.val[i]!.val * rhs.val ≤ U32.max), algo.U32X4.Insts.CoreOpsArithMulAssignU32.mul_assign self rhs ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.val[i]!.val = self.val[i]!.val * rhs.val ⦄

final_inner_iter_wp.statement: ∀ (it : core.slice.iter.ChunksExact U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hc : ∀ c ∈ it.chunks, 4 ≤ c.val.length) (hn : it.chunks.length ≤ 5552) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop1 it a b ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (out.1.val[i]!.val, out.2.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun it.chunks a.val[i]!.val b.val[i]!.val i ⦄

sum_loop_wp.statement: ∀ (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (a : U32) (hmax : a.val + AdlerProof.iterSum it ≤ U32.max), algo.Adler32.compute_loop2 it a ⦃ fun out => out.val = a.val + AdlerProof.iterSum it ⦄

sum_loop3_wp.statement: ∀ (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (a : U32) (hmax : a.val + AdlerProof.iterSum it ≤ U32.max), algo.Adler32.compute_loop3 it a ⦃ fun out => out.val = a.val + AdlerProof.iterSum it ⦄

vector_sum_le.statement: ∀ (v : algo.U32X4) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → v.val[i]!.val ≤ n), (v.val.map (fun x => x.val)).sum ≤ 4 * n

tail_loop_wp.statement: ∀ (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U8) (a b : U32) (ha : (AdlerProof.rawRun (it.slice.val.drop it.i) a.val b.val).1 ≤ U32.max) (hb : (AdlerProof.rawRun (it.slice.val.drop it.i) a.val b.val).2 ≤ U32.max), algo.Adler32.compute_loop4 it a b ⦃ fun out => (out.1.val, out.2.val) = AdlerProof.rawRun (it.slice.val.drop it.i) a.val b.val ⦄

rawRun_mod.statement: ∀ (bytes : List U8) (a b : Nat), ((AdlerProof.rawRun bytes a b).1 % 65521, (AdlerProof.rawRun bytes a b).2 % 65521) = AdlerSpec.run a b bytes

tail_bounded_wp.statement: ∀ (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U8) (a b : U32) (hn : (it.slice.val.drop it.i).length ≤ 3) (ha : a.val ≤ 400000) (hb : b.val ≤ 2000000), algo.Adler32.compute_loop4 it a b ⦃ fun out => (out.1.val, out.2.val) = AdlerProof.rawRun (it.slice.val.drop it.i) a.val b.val ⦄

quartet_recombine.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (hfull : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.val.length = 4) (a b : Nat), let s := AdlerProof.rawRun (cs.map Slice.val).flatten a b; let l := fun i => AdlerProof.laneRun cs 0 0 i; s.1 = a + (l 0).1 + (l 1).1 + (l 2).1 + (l 3).1 ∧ s.2 + (l 1).1 + 2 * (l 2).1 + 3 * (l 3).1 = b + 4 * cs.length * a + 4 * ((l 0).2 + (l 1).2 + (l 2).2 + (l 3).2)

quartet_mod_recombine.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (hfull : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.val.length = 4) (a b : Nat), let l := fun i => AdlerProof.laneRun cs 0 0 i; let av := fun i => (l i).1 % 65521; let bv := fun i => (l i).2 % 65521; ((a + av 0 + av 1 + av 2 + av 3) % 65521, ((b + 4 * cs.length * a) % 65521 + 4 * (bv 0 + bv 1 + bv 2 + bv 3) + (65521 - av 1) + 2 * (65521 - av 2) + 3 * (65521 - av 3)) % 65521) = AdlerSpec.run a b (cs.map Slice.val).flatten

vector_iter_sum.statement: ∀ (v : algo.U32X4), AdlerProof.iterSum { slice := Array.to_slice v, i := 0 } = v.val[0]!.val + v.val[1]!.val + v.val[2]!.val + v.val[3]!.val

run_congr.statement: ∀ (bytes : List U8) (a b c d : Nat) (ha : a % 65521 = c % 65521) (hb : b % 65521 = d % 65521), AdlerSpec.run a b bytes = AdlerSpec.run c d bytes

run_append.statement: ∀ (xs ys : List U8) (a b : Nat), AdlerSpec.run a b (xs ++ ys) = AdlerSpec.run (AdlerSpec.run a b xs).1 (AdlerSpec.run a b xs).2 ys

combine_lane_residues.statement: ∀ (xs ys : List (Slice U8)) (av bv av' bv' : algo.U32X4) (hseed : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun xs 0 0 i).1 % 65521 ∧ bv.val[i]!.val = (AdlerProof.laneRun xs 0 0 i).2 % 65521) (hfinal : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (av'.val[i]!.val, bv'.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun ys av.val[i]!.val bv.val[i]!.val i), ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av'.val[i]!.val % 65521 = (AdlerProof.laneRun (xs ++ ys) 0 0 i).1 % 65521 ∧ bv'.val[i]!.val % 65521 = (AdlerProof.laneRun (xs ++ ys) 0 0 i).2 % 65521
